build_lr_scheduler_myle: build a learning rate scheduler using the myle schedule with warmup steps for an optimizer
build_lr_scheduler_cosine: build a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler with warmup and final learning rate decay
build_lr_scheduler_wsd: build a three stage learning rate scheduler with warmup, steady, and decay phases
build_lr_scheduler_polynomial: build a polynomial decay learning rate scheduler with configurable power and warmup steps
build_lr_scheduler_noop: build a noop learning rate scheduler that keeps the learning rate constant throughout training
